# A schema named inside a file cannot reach outside the file's directory,
# fetch a URL, or follow a symlink out; -schema is trusted.
! yamlschema up.yaml
stderr 'leaves the file.s directory'
! yamlschema url.yaml
stderr 'pass -remote'
! yamlschema scheme.yaml
stderr 'only http and https'
! yamlschema none.yaml
stderr 'no schema'
yamlschema -schema schema.json sub/plain.yaml

-- schema.json --
{"type":"object"}
-- up.yaml --
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema.json
a: 1
-- url.yaml --
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://example.com/s.json
a: 1
-- scheme.yaml --
# yaml-language-server: $schema=file:///etc/hosts
a: 1
-- none.yaml --
a: 1
-- sub/plain.yaml --
a: 1
